content.title: Dr. Zulfiqar Bhutta Highlights Research's Role in Climate Action During We Don't Have Time Climate Week NYC Panel
content.summary: Dr. Zulfiqar Bhutta, Director of the Institute for Global Health and Development, took part in a panel during We Don't Have Time Climate Week NYC, emphasizing the pivotal role of research as a catalyst for addressing the climate crisis.

content.text: During the recent We Don't Have Time Climate Week NYC broadcast held on September 21, 2023, an essential dialogue unfolded, addressing critical pre-COP28 topics. The discussion scrutinized the impact of ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) in propelling genuine climate action versus inadvertently aiding corporate greenwashing. Furthermore, it delved into the prospect of achieving climate-neutral food systems and explored strategies for transcending GDP measurements to combat the climate crisis effectively.

Dr. Zulfiqar Bhutta, Director of the Institute for Global Health and Development, contributed his expertise to a panel discussion during this broadcast, emphasizing the pivotal role of research as a catalyst for transformative change. As the world's attention turns towards COP28 in Dubai, this event served as a gathering point for leaders, diplomats, business executives, NGO representatives, and climate activists, fostering deliberations on the critical actions needed to address the climate crisis comprehensively. Dr. Bhutta's active participation underscored research's indispensable role in shaping sustainable solutions for a brighter future.
